decision.llm_reasoning: The course title and content are entirely focused on ASP.NET Core development, including architecture, database operations, and security.

evidence.text: This course provides knowledge and skills for developing dynamic web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC. Upon completion, students will master modern web architecture, the MVC pattern, database operations via Entity Framework Core, user interface building with Razor, form handling and validation, user management with Authentication & Authorization, as well as developing practical applications with basic business logic. Additionally, the course fosters professional ethics, personal responsibility, and compliance with legal regulations during the development and deployment of web applications.
Explain the operating mechanisms of ASP.NET Core, Middleware, and Dependency Injection.
Build flexible, highly interactive web interfaces using Razor Pages, HTML5, CSS3, and professional form handling.
Possess the ability to configure, test, and deploy applications on hosting or server environments.
Apply basic knowledge of web programming and the MVC architectural pattern to design, build, and operate web applications.
Apply modern software development processes, adhering to professional principles, laws, and ethics in deploying web applications according to practical requirements.
Overview & MVC Pattern in ASP.NET Core
ASP.NET Core Fundamentals and Entity Framework Core
Form the habit of updating new technologies within the .NET ecosystem to solve practical problems.
